query: an artifact that costs one and taps for two colorless mana
relevant: Sol Ring
notes: Other cards tap for {C}{C} but cost 3 or more.

query: one-mana white instant that exiles a creature, and its controller gains life equal to its power
relevant: Swords to Plowshares; Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares
notes: The second is a two-faced card whose back face is Swords.

query: exile a creature, and its controller gets to search for a basic land
relevant: Path to Exile

query: green sorcery that finds two basic lands, one onto the battlefield tapped and one into your hand
relevant: Cultivate; Kodama's Reach; Flare of Cultivation; Peregrination
notes: Navigation Orb and Troop of Ponies do the same but aren't green sorceries.

query: four-mana sorcery that destroys all creatures, and they can't be regenerated
relevant: Wrath of God; Damnation

query: counter target spell for two blue mana
relevant: Counterspell
notes: Cancel has the same text but costs three.

query: black sorcery that searches your library for any card and puts it into your hand
relevant: Demonic Tutor; Diabolic Tutor

query: equipment that draws two cards when the equipped creature dies
relevant: Skullclamp

query: a land that taps for any color in your commander's color identity
relevant: Command Tower; Path of Ancestry; Opal Palace; Hidden Hideout
notes: Arcane Signet and Commander's Sphere do this too, but aren't lands.

query: an enchantment that doubles the tokens you create
relevant: Anointed Procession; Doubling Season; Parallel Lives; Primal Vigor
notes: Primal Vigor doubles everyone's tokens. Creatures that double tokens (Mondrak, Bard) excluded.

query: sacrifice a creature to add colorless mana
relevant: Ashnod's Altar; Transmogrant Altar
notes: Phyrexian Altar adds colored mana, so it's excluded.

query: every player sacrifices their creatures, then the creatures in graveyards come back
relevant: Living Death; Living End

query: equipment that gives a creature haste and stops it being targeted
relevant: Lightning Greaves; Swiftfoot Boots

query: whenever an opponent casts a spell, you draw a card unless they pay one
relevant: Rhystic Study

query: whenever an opponent draws a card, you get a Treasure unless they pay two
relevant: Smothering Tithe
notes: Tataru Taru is similar but conditional, so it's excluded.

query: bounce a nonland permanent you don't control, or overload it to bounce all of them
relevant: Cyclonic Rift

query: a land that gives you no maximum hand size
relevant: Reliquary Tower
notes: Sea Gate Restoration's land face doesn't have the ability.

query: sacrifice a land to put your commander into your hand from the command zone
relevant: Command Beacon

query: ripple
relevant: Surging Aether; Surging Dementia; Surging Flame; Surging Might; Surging Sentinels
notes: Every legal card with ripple.

query: epic
relevant: Endless Swarm; Enduring Ideal; Eternal Dominion; Neverending Torment; Undying Flames
notes: Every legal card with epic.

query: gravestorm
relevant: Bitter Ordeal; Follow the Bodies; Ominous Harvest
notes: Every legal card with gravestorm.

query: Atraxa
relevant: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice; Atraxa, Grand Unifier
notes: Atraxa's Fall and Atraxa's Skitterfang share the name but aren't the legend.

query: kodamas reach
relevant: Kodama's Reach
notes: A name typed without its apostrophe.

query: counterspells
relevant: Confirm Suspicions; Keep Safe; Neutralize; Vex; Voidslime
notes: Mindreaver excluded: it only counters spells sharing a name with exiled cards.

query: ways to destroy an artifact or enchantment
relevant: Fracture; Loran of the Third Path; Woodfall Primus; Deem Inferior
notes: Deem Inferior tucks rather than destroys; included as it answers any nonland permanent.

query: cheap ramp
relevant: Sanctum Weaver; Return from the Wilds; Bucknard's Everfull Purse; Commander's Sphere; Darksteel Ingot; Luck Bobblehead
notes: Golden Egg (one-shot), Magic Pot (on death), Vine Gecko and Foundry Inspector (narrow cost reduction) excluded.

query: repeatable card draw
relevant: Triumph of Ferocity; Thickest in the Thicket; Terrasymbiosis; Case of the Locked Hothouse; Level Up; Ginger, Queen of Sweets
notes: Ginger draws through the monarch. Harmonize is one-shot; Gate to the Afterlife only loots.

query: board wipes that kill every creature
relevant: Game Over; Phyrexian Scriptures; Novablast Wurm; Whipflare; Destructive Force; Decree of Annihilation; Do or Die
notes: Excluded: Inundate (bounce), Extinction (one type), Worldslayer, Ajani's -4, Noxious Field (1 damage per tap).

query: return a creature card from my graveyard to the battlefield
relevant: Anti-Venom, Horrifying Healer; Obsessive Stitcher; Reunion of the House; Thrilling Encore
notes: Cards that only return themselves are excluded.

query: get cards back from my graveyard to my hand
relevant: Evolution Charm; Evolution Witness; Invasion of Shandalar // Leyline Surge; Palace Siege; Divergent Equation; Dark Intimations; Maestros Confluence; Kami of the Palace Fields; Dawn-Blessed Pennant
notes: Hua Tuo puts on top of library; Savvy Trader plays from exile; both excluded.

query: make Treasure tokens
relevant: Bucknard's Everfull Purse; Magic Pot; Luck Bobblehead

query: give my creature hexproof, shroud or ward
relevant: Magic Damper; Ghosthelm Courier; Pemmin's Aura; Crystal Carapace
notes: Other protection (phasing, protection from opponents, indestructible) is excluded.

query: cheap burn to kill a creature
relevant: Engulfing Flames; Jaya's Greeting; Thundering Rebuke; Wild Slash

query: steal an opponent's creature
relevant: Illicit Auction; Might Makes Right; Swooping Pteranodon
notes: The last two take it until end of turn.

query: tutor: search my library for a creature card
relevant: Survival of the Fittest
notes: Birthing Ritual and Vivien's Invocation dig the top seven cards rather than search.

query: lands that tap for two colors
relevant: Floodfarm Verge; Gleaming Bastion; Shivan Oasis; Viridescent Bog
notes: Cactus Preserve and Archaeological Dig make any color; excluded.

query: mana rocks that tap for any color
relevant: Commander's Sphere; Darksteel Ingot; Luck Bobblehead
notes: Golden Egg is one-shot; excluded.

query: equipment that gives haste
relevant: Strider Harness; Rocket-Powered Goblin Glider

query: stop opposing creatures from blocking
relevant: Abandon the Post; Bellowing Bruiser // Beat a Path; Unearthly Blizzard; Forgehammer Centurion; Nacatl Hunt-Pride; Rumbling Ruin
notes: Evasion for my own creatures (Tezzeret's Gatebreaker) is excluded.

query: mill an opponent
relevant: Crosstown Courier; Merrow Witsniper; Tenured Oilcaster; Vexing Arcanix
notes: Mindreaver exiles rather than mills; excluded.

query: tap down opposing creatures
relevant: Eddymurk Crab; Permafrost Trap; The Wondrous Wasp

query: flicker a creature: exile it and return it to the battlefield
relevant: Siren's Ruse; Spaceshift

query: take an extra turn
relevant: Teferi, Master of Time; Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting

query: copy my instant and sorcery spells
relevant: Resonance Technician; Prismari, the Inspiration
notes: Mirrorwing Dragon copies spells that target it, mostly opponents'; excluded.
